IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: FUNDRAISING ACTIVITIES FOR VISTA HILL FOUNDATION, A 501(C)(3) ORGANIZATION.
IRS990.MissionDesc: TO PROVIDE SUPPORT TO VISTA HILL FOUNDATION, A 501(C)3 PUBLIC CHARITY ORGANIZATION, BY CONDUCTING FUNDRAISING ACTIVITIES TO ASSIST THE FOUNDATION WITH ITS MISSION OF PROVIDING QUALITY BEHAVIORAL PROGRAMS FOR CHILDREN, ADOLESCENTS, AND ADULTS IN NEED THROUGHOUT SAN DIEGO.
IRS990.Desc: OBTAIN AND PROVIDE FUNDS AND FUNDING RESOURCES IN SUPPORT OF VISTA HILL FOUNDATIONS PROGRAMS WHICH INCLUDE EARLY INTERVENTION AND EDUCATION SERVICES THAT HELP PEOPLE STRUGGLING WITH MENTAL ILLNESS, DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES, AND CHEMICAL DEPENDENCIES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part V, Line 4: Intended uses of the endowment fund.
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION'S ENDOWMENTS CONSIST OF FIVE INDIVIDUAL FUNDS ESTABLISHED FOR A VARIETY OF PURPOSES.

The Organizations are a public charity, and are exempt from income taxes under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code and Section 23701(d) of the California Revenue and Taxation Code. The Organizations, however, may occasionally be subject to taxes on unrelated business income. The Organizations believe that they have appropriate support for any tax positions taken, and, as such, do not have any uncertain tax positions that are material to the combined financial statements. The Organizations are not a private foundation. The Organizations Return of Organization Exempt from Income Tax for the years ended September 30, 2024, 2023, 2022, and 2021 are subject to examination by the Internal Revenue Service and State taxing Authorities, generally three-to-four years after the returns were filed.
